caliper_mm.basis: derived.thickness; physical.caliper_um estimated: nominal 1.5 mm board (brief) [E]

areal_density_kg_m2.basis: derived.areal_density (g/mm²) × 1000; physical.gsm estimated: ≈ 0.73 g/cm³ recycled greyboard × 1.5 mm [E]

E1t.basis: derived.E_md × t; physical.E_md_gpa estimated: recycled board, low-modulus mixed fibre [E]; physical.caliper_um estimated: nominal 1.5 mm board (brief) [E]

E2t.basis: derived.E_cd × t; physical.E_cd_gpa estimated: weak grain in multi-cylinder board, MD/CD ≈ 1.4 [E]; physical.caliper_um estimated: nominal 1.5 mm board (brief) [E]

G12t.basis: derived.G12 × t, G12 = 0.387·√(E_md·E_cd) (Baum, Brennan & Habeger 1981, via pliego.stock.derive v1)

nu12.basis: ν12 = ν·√(E_md/E_cd): the card's ν is the geometric mean √(ν12·ν21), split by reciprocity ν12/E1 = ν21/E2; physical.nu estimated: √(ν12·ν21) = 0.293 for machine-made paper (Baum et al. 1981)

D11.basis: derived.D_md × 1e-9 (N·m), plate E·t³/(12(1−ν²)) in pliego.stock.derive v1; physical.E_md_gpa estimated: recycled board, low-modulus mixed fibre [E]; physical.nu estimated: √(ν12·ν21) = 0.293 for machine-made paper (Baum et al. 1981); physical.caliper_um estimated: nominal 1.5 mm board (brief) [E]

D22.basis: derived.D_cd × 1e-9 (N·m), plate E·t³/(12(1−ν²)) in pliego.stock.derive v1; physical.E_cd_gpa estimated: weak grain in multi-cylinder board, MD/CD ≈ 1.4 [E]; physical.nu estimated: √(ν12·ν21) = 0.293 for machine-made paper (Baum et al. 1981); physical.caliper_um estimated: nominal 1.5 mm board (brief) [E]

D66.basis: G12·t³/12 with the estimated G12 above

crease_length_scale_t.basis: physical.crease_length_scale_t estimated: scored board: L* = 50–100 t (memo §a3, Beex & Peerlings 2009 qualitative); mid value [E]

crease_yield_deg.basis: physical.crease_yield_deg estimated: rest opening 27–43° after creasing (Lechenault 2014, Mylar); board unmeasured [E]

crease_set_rate.basis: pliego.stock.derive v1 default (card has no physical.crease_set_rate)

score_factor.basis: pliego.stock.derive v1 default (card has no physical.score_factor)

notes: friction: the card states one paper-on-paper coefficient; it is written as friction_static, and friction_kinetic and damping are left out rather than invented
